Task Fix a bug in the complex math calculation function calculate_entropy() in math_utils.py. The function should calculate Shannon entropy: H(X) = -sum(p(x) * log2(p(x))) Curre

tools.name: check_task_completion
tools.effect: state['items'] = [dict(x, status='completed') if x['id'] == args.get('item_id') else x for x in state['items']]
